g.text: Cue — Animation Creation Flow (FR-03, FR-04, FR-05, FR-06)
Keyframe upload, optional English instruction, plan approval, job submission
S3 Keyframe upload (repeated for the Start slot and the End slot)
[API] Check session, stream to temp file
[API] Validate real content type, size, dimensions
[MS] Write file (temp file, fsync, atomic rename)
[API] 500, file stays orphaned until the sweeper removes it
Both slots hold a valid image?
[SPA] "Continue to motion" (enabled only when both drawings are valid)
S4 Optional English instruction and plan
[SPA] Drawings-only run, no plan is created
[PLN] Local LLM proposes a structured plan, rule validator checks it
[SPA] Show reasoned rejection, text stays editable
[API] Check session, ownership and "not yet attached" for both drawings
[API] Re-validate the plan against the schema, draw a random seed
[DB] Advisory lock on owner and idempotency key, then INSERT animation_job (status queued) ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING
Per-user active job limit: decision D-07 (pending).
If adopted, a rejection branch is added here.
[API] Return the existing job, no second job
Box colour = layer: blue SPA, green API, amber DB or media store (MS), purple plan interpreter (PLN).
Uploads happen before any job exists; unattached drawings are removed after 24 h (maintenance).
An empty instruction never calls the language model (FR-05 "generation without command").
